facts.source_fact: The 2026 methodology note describes several LULUCF method changes for UK GHG statistics.
facts.expected_handling: Preserve method-note version and LULUCF scope.

facts.source_fact: Forest-carbon accounting is updated to better reflect tree species and growth rates for afforestation from 2011.
The forest model adds deadwood from natural competition among young trees and improves estimation of carbon transfer from dead branches into soil.
Forest modelling is revised to improve consistency with wood-production estimates and incorporates new forest-planting and wood-production activity data.
facts.expected_handling: Carry activity-data vintage with forest estimates.

facts.source_fact: The forest-model changes reduce net forestry and harvested-wood-products emissions across the time series.
facts.expected_handling: Treat direction as model impact rather than new direct measurement.

facts.source_fact: Peatland modelling incorporates Defra-funded field-study evidence on historic domestic peat-extraction areas.
Peatland modelling incorporates Defra rewetting data for 2021-2024 and the Peatland ACTION programme for Scotland.
The peatland changes lead to a small reduction in net emissions across the time series.
facts.expected_handling: Keep net-emission sign and model context explicit.

facts.source_fact: Cropland and biomass-carbon-stock modelling incorporates data from the 2024 Agricultural Census for England.
facts.expected_handling: Bind cropland changes to England census provenance.

facts.source_fact: The cropland and biomass-carbon-stock update leads to a small increase in net emissions across the time series.
facts.expected_handling: Preserve direction, scope and time-series context.

guard_patterns.handling: Keep biomass, deadwood, soil and harvested-wood pools distinct.
Carry planting, wood-production, rewetting and census data vintages.
Preserve UK, England and Scotland-specific evidence boundaries.
Preserve emissions versus removals and sign convention.
Apply revised method consistently across the series.
Cross-check final production values against final release.
Do not infer parcel carbon stocks or emissions from national methodology.
Flag unresolved pool, geography, sign or input conflicts.

generation_rule: CARTESIAN_PRODUCT facts x guard_patterns; 10 x 10 = 100 controls
